description: Verifies that an A -> B -> C -> A storage mutation loop is completely pruned by identity-transition pruning (semantic_contract.md §3.1), and that the surviving sender deltas (nonce increment, gas billing) are still recorded.
notes: storage_updates is [] (not omitted) because the account itself has a real delta (nonce, balance) -- only the slot 0x0a identity transition is pruned, per the Minimality invariant in semantic_contract.md §4. The balance figure above is illustrative gas billing, not a precisely metered value; an implementation should replace it with the real Prague-spec gas accounting for this opcode sequence.
